title: Lynn's Quantised Creepers
description: A resource pack that uses Paint.NET's "Quantise" feature to lower the number of colours on the Creeper's texture from *692* down to just 15, not counting transparency.
body: A simple resource pack where, using the laziest method possible ([Paint.NET](https://getpaint.net/)'s "Quantise" effect), I reduced the amount of colours on the Creeper's textures from the frankly _ludicrous_ 692 (no really, I checked) to a more modest 15.
